project_title: Learning Dynamic Objective Interaction Manifolds for Adaptive Multi-Objective Deep Reinforcement Learning in Real-Time Traffic Systems
target_venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (IEEE T-ITS)

1_confirmatory_experimental_completeness.name: Confirmatory Experimental Completeness
1_confirmatory_experimental_completeness.criteria: Full 105 evaluation runs executed across 7 algorithms, 3 distinct network scenarios, and 5 independent seeds with zero fabricated results.

2_statistical_reliability_and_significan.name: Statistical Reliability and Significance
2_statistical_reliability_and_significan.criteria: Rigorous degrees of freedom distinction (paired t-test df=4, pooled LMM df=72), non-parametric Wilcoxon (N=15), and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction (q=0.05).

3_comparative_baseline_performance.name: Comparative Baseline Performance
3_comparative_baseline_performance.criteria: Rigorous comparison against Webster Fixed-Time, NEMA Actuated, Max-Pressure, FW-PPO, SA-PPO, and MLP-PPO with explicit diagnosis of safety shield parasitism.

4_multiobjective_and_pareto_validation.name: Multi-Objective and Pareto Validation
4_multiobjective_and_pareto_validation.criteria: 5D objective space optimization, non-dominated Pareto frontier extraction, and hypervolume expansion proof against reference (1.2, 1.2, 1.2, 1.2, 1.2).

5_generalization_and_distribution_shift.name: Generalization and Distribution-Shift Robustness
5_generalization_and_distribution_shift.criteria: Evaluation across held-out traffic regimes (nominal grid, high-speed arterial progression, incident disruption) with degradation ratio quantification.

6_empirical_safety_and_robustness.name: Empirical Safety and Robustness
6_empirical_safety_and_robustness.criteria: Zero conflicting green signal states across all steps, zero clearance violations (>=3s yellow), min-green enforcement (>=10s), and 100% adversarial attack interception.

7_component_ablation_and_contribution_va.name: Component Ablation and Contribution Validation
7_component_ablation_and_contribution_va.criteria: Isolation of SCOIL dynamic interaction manifold M(s) vs M=0, rolling Pearson correlation, and GCN-GRU topology with spectral coupling analysis.

8_reproducibility_and_independent_verifi.name: Reproducibility and Independent Verification
8_reproducibility_and_independent_verifi.criteria: Cryptographic SHA-256 checkpoint hashing, schema-validated manifests, deterministic seed reproduction, and fully automated verification pipelines.
